motivation: Second externally-sourced verified break. Discovery source = jackson-core 2.15.0 changelog/release notes (external-mining SOURCE #2), NOT BUMP and NOT the CVE advisory feed. Contrast the REJECTED jackson-databind default-typing break (see catalog): default-typing is greenfield-Redis-config + API-migration, not same-code-now-throws; StreamReadConstraints IS a clean same-code-now-throws limit break.

external_source.changelog: jackson-core 2.15.0 release notes — StreamReadConstraints (default maxNestingDepth=1000, maxNumberLength=1000, maxStringLength)
external_source.discovered_via: domain knowledge / release notes (external-mining source #2), NOT the CVE advisory miner

behavioral_break.exception: com.fasterxml.jackson.core.exc.StreamConstraintsException: Depth (1001) exceeds the maximum allowed nesting depth (1000)
behavioral_break.affected_input: JSON nested 1001 levels deep (one past the 2.15 default maxNestingDepth of 1000)
behavioral_break.why_it_breaks: jackson-core 2.15.0 added StreamReadConstraints default parser limits. Deeply-nested / very-long JSON that 2.14 parsed now throws StreamConstraintsException at parse time. `new ObjectMapper().readTree(json)` compiles unchanged; it throws at runtime on previously-accepted input -> behavioural break.

adaptation.summary: Rebuild the ObjectMapper on a JsonFactory whose StreamReadConstraints raise the limit the 2.15 default now enforces. Analogue of json-smart's max-depth config.

real_clients_signature_confirmed.message: fix: raise Jackson StreamReadConstraints limit in ContentletJsonHelper (#35394)
fix(JacksonConfigurator): add support for StreamReadConstraints in Jackson 2.15
Upgrade Jackson to 2.15.0, and add effectively disabling of StreamReadConstraints
set the Jackson StreamReadConstraints maxStringLength to 50 MB

verification.method: 3-state differential build+test with Maven on JDK 11; jackson version swapped via -Djackson.version; parent vs adapted selected via Maven profile (-Pparent / -Padapted) because adapted uses the 2.15-only StreamReadConstraints API.

verification.conclusion: Confirmed behavioural break with a production-side adaptation: `new ObjectMapper().readTree()` of deeply-nested JSON breaks only under jackson-core >=2.15 with otherwise-unchanged code, and raising StreamReadConstraints in production code resolves it. Break + adaptation pattern taken from the real signature_confirmed clients above.
